_comment: Structural heading vocabulary, per language, used to pick digest §2.2 units
out of a spatial tree whose levels are unreliable (see utils/chapter_units.py).
'keywords' are PREFIX forms: the ordinal follows the word (Глава 1, Chương 1).
'patterns' are for languages where the ordinal is infixed or suffixed
(第1章); each entry is a full anchored regex with the ordinal in group 1.
All languages are merged by default — matching is anchored and length-capped,
so cross-language entries do not collide in practice. Add a language by adding
a key here; no code change is required.
'appendix' is the only kind allowed to appear without an ordinal, because books
routinely carry a single unnumbered appendix.
